name: Microsoft Entra User Sync
description: Utility module to sync users in Microsoft Entra with users in Drupal, via the MS Graph API.

suggests.queue_ui:queue_ui: Adds a UI to inspect and process the entrasync_user_processor queue on demand.
suggests.openid_connect:openid_connect: Lets the imported Entra users log in with their Entra ID.

project_description: EntraSync connects to a Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) tenant through the MS Graph API and imports the tenant's users into Drupal entities (users or nodes). Each import is a configuration entity ("sync") that names a Graph key, the Entra user properties to fetch, an optional post-fetch filter, a storage plugin (user or node) and its field/label/status/role/bundle mapping. Fetched users are distilled to the selected properties, optionally reduced by a filter, and queued for background processing via the Queue API. A managed-entities table links each Entra GUID to the Drupal entity it created so later syncs can update it (including blocking/unpublishing when the account is disabled in Entra). Delta queries make the first sync fetch all users while later syncs fetch only new or changed users. Syncs can run on cron or be triggered manually. Two events allow altering the distilled user list and the Drupal entity before save. Authentication is delegated entirely to the Microsoft Graph API module, which stores tenant credentials as a Key entity; EntraSync only references the chosen key by id.
